name: oriel-e2e
description: Docker-backed Playwright E2E suite for the Oriel forms plugin.

scripts.env:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && npm run env:bootstrap
scripts.env:bootstrap: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm cli sh /opt/oriel/bootstrap.sh
scripts.env:flush-cache: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec nginx sh -c 'rm -rf /var/cache/nginx/oriel/* && nginx -s reload'
scripts.env:wp: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm cli wp
